title: Mode Profile Composition Contract
summary: Compose B2B, B2C, C2C, D2C and B4B capability and policy profiles with safe transitions; editions stay separate.

criteria: mode profile composition binds an active capability set plus the pricing, checkout, tax and permission decisions that a business model implies into one tenant and channel scoped profile.
The supported business models are B2B, B2C, C2C, D2C and B4B, and a tenant may run more than one of them on separate channels without cloning its data.
Composition is a versioned composition: a profile carries a version, and a transition moves a tenant and channel from one pinned version to another rather than mutating in place.
The transition chain is preview, dry-run, validate, publish and rollback; publish is reachable only after validate succeeds and rollback returns to the previously published version.
live data preservation is invariant across every transition: switching a mode changes capability flags and decisions, never the tenant's stored records.
ArcheType-scoped mode profile ownership stays with archetype-mode-profile-contract; this contract composes tenant and channel level profiles from what that contract defines.
capability catalog definition is excluded, authorization decision is excluded and editions and packaging are excluded; each is named without asserting that it is decided here.

risks.desc: A mode transition implemented as a reconfiguration rather than a versioned composition could drop the records created under the previous capability set, which is unrecoverable for a live tenant.
risks.mitigation: Pin every profile as a version, require validate before publish and prove live data preservation across a forward transition followed by a rollback.

risks.desc: Allowing a profile to declare a capability the catalog does not define would create an ungoverned permission surface that no authorization decision can evaluate.
risks.mitigation: Keep capability catalog definition excluded, admit only catalog-defined ids into a composition and refuse an unknown capability id fail-closed.

risks.desc: A composed profile could be misread as deciding access, duplicating the PDP and producing two conflicting answers for the same request.
risks.mitigation: State that authorization decision is excluded, treat the profile as one input to the PDP and prove a profile cannot override a returned decision.

risks.desc: Composition could drift into commercial packaging and start acting as an edition or pricing engine, duplicating an authority that lives outside the kernel.
risks.mitigation: Keep editions and packaging excluded and pricing, checkout and tax execution excluded, and preserve NO-GO without new human authority.

featureDefs.title: Özellik Tanımları
items: mode profile composition sağlar a tenant and channel scoped profile that binds an active capability set to the business model a tenant actually runs.

Girdi is a selected business model among B2B, B2C, C2C, D2C and B4B plus the tenant and channel scope; çıktı is a versioned composition carrying the active capability set and the decisions it implies.
The transition chain is preview, dry-run, validate, publish and rollback, and publish is unreachable until validate has succeeded.
live data preservation is invariant: a transition changes capability flags and decisions and never destroys or rewrites tenant records, and tenant isolation holds throughout.
Kapsam sınırı gereği capability catalog definition is excluded, authorization decision is excluded, editions and packaging are excluded and pricing, checkout and tax execution are excluded.

featureDefs.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract featureDefs kapsamı. Kapsa: tenant and channel scoped composition, the five business models, versioned transitions through preview, dry-run, validate, publish and rollback, live data preservation. Exclude capability catalog definition, authorization decision, editions and packaging, pricing, checkout and tax execution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

security.title: Güvenlik Önlemleri
items: A composition changes yetki surface, so tenant isolation is the primary control: a profile transition for one tenant and channel can never widen another tenant's active capability set.
capability catalog definition is excluded, so a profile may activate only catalog-defined capability ids and an unknown id is refused fail-closed rather than created.
authorization decision is excluded: the PDP stays the deciding authority, the profile is one input, and a composition can never override a returned deny.
Publish and rollback are privileged transitions guarded by explicit approval, and each leaves an append-only denetim izi carrying tenant, channel, previous version and new version.
A preview or dry-run runs against an isolated evaluation copy, so inspecting a candidate profile cannot leak or alter the live active capability set.

security.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract security kapsamı. Kapsa: tenant isolation across transitions, catalog-only capability activation, PDP as the deciding authority, approval-gated publish and rollback with append-only audit, isolated preview evaluation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

codeOptimization.title: Kod Optimizasyonu
items: The planned handoff keeps one tipli composition katman so the five business models cannot develop divergent transition rules per model.
Composition and validation stay pure functions with low karmaşıklık, evaluated against a candidate version without touching the published one.
Ölü kod and speculative per-model branches are refused, the short-code bütçe is respected, and engineering rules are reached through standardRefs rather than restated here.

securityOptimization.title: Güvenlik Optimizasyonu
items: En az ayrıcalık applies to transitions: composing a candidate is a lower privilege than publishing it, and rollback authority is granted separately from publish authority.
The composable model set is an allowlist of B2B, B2C, C2C, D2C and B4B, so an unknown model string is refused rather than treated as a permissive default.
The activation yüzey stays kapalı: a profile can only narrow or widen within the capability catalog, and no transition path can reach an editions or pricing authority.
Publish rate is bounded per tenant and channel so a transition loop cannot be used to churn the active capability set or mask an unauthorized widening.
securityOptimization.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/securityOptimization: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
securityOptimization.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract securityOptimization kapsamı. Kapsa: separated compose, publish and rollback privileges, allowlisted business models, closed activation surface within the catalog, bounded publish rate. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

performance.title: Performans Optimizasyonu
items: A p95 budget is declared for resolving the active capability set on the request path and a separate budget for a full validate pass before publish; no measurement is claimed here.
The published composition is read through a bounded önbellek keyed by tenant, channel and version and invalidated on publish or rollback, so resolution is not recomputed per request.
Validation must avoid N+1 access: the candidate profile is checked against the capability catalog in one pass rather than once per capability.
performance.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/performance: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
performance.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract performance kapsamı. Kapsa: p95 budgets for capability-set resolution and full validate, version-keyed cache invalidated on publish and rollback, single-pass catalog validation. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

mobileApps.title: Mobil Uygulama Uyumu
items: A mobil client resolves the same active capability set as the web surface for its tenant and channel; a cihaz may not cache a profile past a publish or rollback.
An offline client shows the last resolved profile version as stale and refuses to queue a transition for later replay, since publish requires a live validate.
No mobile-only mode or capability is introduced here; rendering a composed profile stays a separate consumer responsibility.
mobileApps.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/mobileApps: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
mobileApps.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract mobileApps kapsamı. Kapsa: identical capability-set resolution on mobile, no caching past a transition, stale offline display without queued transitions, no mobile-only mode. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

wcag.title: WCAG 2.2 AAA
items: Any future transition surface must convey the difference between a preview, a validated candidate and a published profile through text rather than colour alone, at the WCAG AAA kontrast threshold with a visible odak ring.
A validate failure or a rollback must be announced through an aria live region naming the version and the outcome, so a klavye-only operator is never left guessing.
This contract defines composition semantics only, so no accessibility conformance may be recorded here and every such result stays planned.
wcag.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/wcag: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
wcag.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract wcag kapsamı. Kapsa: non-colour-only distinction between preview, candidate and published at AAA contrast, announced validate failures and rollbacks, keyboard-first operation, semantics-only scope. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

deployment.title: Dağıtım (Swarm/K8s/Shared)
items: This shard performs no release or deploy; the hosting topology and container dağıtım of any composition service remain human-developer work behind ops-plane authority.
Publishing a new profile version is a data-level change behind human approval and must not require a redeploy; rollback returns to the previous version without touching tenant data.
Reverting this composition shard changes the planning contract and the projections derived from it, never a live tenant profile, so runtimeDataImpact stays none and NO-GO remains in force.
deployment.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/deployment: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
deployment.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract deployment kapsamı. Kapsa: no release or deploy here, hosting owned by the ops plane, data-level publish without redeploy, bounded withdrawal. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

eca.title: ECA Kuralları
items: A publish or rollback olay may be announced so consumers refresh their resolved capability set, but this contract never performs a business action on the tenant's behalf.
A reaction chain raised from a transition olay stops at maxChainDepth 6, so a publish cannot cascade into an unbounded revalidation storm.
Re-delivering the same transition olay must be idempotent, and every publish or rollback requires an explicit onay before it takes effect.
eca.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/eca: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
eca.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract eca kapsamı. Kapsa: transition events without acting for the tenant, depth-bounded reaction chains, idempotent replay and approval-gated publish and rollback. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

aiAgents.title: AI Ajan Davranışı
items: An AI lane is limited to reading this contract and drafting a changeset; app or module generation, app or module update, ruleset override and direct production write all stay yasak.
AI cannot publish a profile version, cannot roll one back and cannot widen an active capability set; each of those needs insan onayı with a step-up review.

Any tenant-supplied payload reaching the lane as sub_prompt is güvenilmez, the kill-switch stays reachable, and no prompt or repository prose may widen this shard's fixed D01 sınır or claim an unexecuted test result.
aiAgents.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/aiAgents: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
aiAgents.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract aiAgents kapsamı. Kapsa: read and draft-changeset only, AI barred from publishing, rolling back or widening a capability set, untrusted sub_prompt and kill switch. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

testing.title: Testler & QA
items: Planned positive cases compose one profile per business model and assert the resulting active capability set matches the declaration, as birim and entegrasyon matrices.
Planned negatif cases prove publish without a successful validate is refused and that a preview or dry-run never mutates a live profile.
Planned negatif cases prove rollback restores the previously published version exactly and that live data preservation holds across a forward transition followed by a rollback.
Planned negatif cases prove a profile cannot activate an undefined capability and cannot override an authorization decision returned by the PDP.
Composition results are recordable only from a human-approved run that truly executed, so the planned matrices here are never counted as passing tests.
testing.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/testing: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
testing.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract testing kapsamı. Kapsa: per-model composition positives, validate-before-publish negatives, rollback and data-preservation negatives, undefined-capability and PDP-override negatives. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

owasp.title: OWASP & Standartlar
items: OWASP A01 broken access control is the defining axis: a composition changes what a tenant may do, so an unauthorized transition is an access control failure rather than a configuration error.
OWASP A04 insecure design is modeled by requiring validate before publish and by keeping capability activation inside the catalog, so no transition path can invent a permission.
OWASP A08 software and data integrity failures is modeled by versioned compositions and append-only transition history, so a published profile cannot be silently rewritten.

Girdi doğrulama applies to the composition request: the business model, tenant, channel and capability ids are validated against allowlists before a candidate is built, and every transition leaves a denetim izi.
owasp.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/owasp: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
owasp.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract owasp kapsamı. Kapsa: A01 via transition authorization, A04 via validate-before-publish and catalog-bound activation, A08 via versioning and append-only history, allowlist input validation with audit. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

integration.title: Kernel/Core Entegrasyonu
items: Kernel integration is contributor -> app-kernel/k-archetype-mode-profile with contributionKind specification, targetProviderIds [k-mode] and runtimeProviderClaimAllowed=false.
All three publicBoundary flags stay false, so a composition touches no kernel internal, no kernel database and no cross-context write path; a transition is announced as an olay instead.
This schedule is only a planning window; predecessor archetype-mode-profile-contract ends 2028-06-09, so no executable-order or readiness claim is allowed.

Bağımlılık yönü stays exactly archetype-mode-profile-contract, party-role-context-contract and policy-decision-point-contract, and the parent-only k-capability edge and the parent related list are not inherited.
Scope stays inside the composition sözleşme: capability catalog definition, authorization decision, editions and packaging and pricing, checkout and tax execution all stay outside.
integration.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/integration: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
integration.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract integration kapsamı. Kapsa: contributor routing under areaId k-archetype-mode-profile to provider k-mode, closed public boundary, exact dependsOn, planning window marker and the fixed exclusion set. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

moduleUsage.title: Modül Kullanımı
items: A consuming module tüketir the active capability set through this contract and may not reach a doğrudan tablo for profile or capability rows.
A consumer must carry the resolved profile version with any cached decision, so a stale capability set cannot outlive the publish that replaced it.
Owning the capability catalog, the authorization decision and the commercial edition belongs elsewhere; this sözleşme composes and never defines them.
moduleUsage.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/moduleUsage: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
moduleUsage.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract moduleUsage kapsamı. Kapsa: contract-mediated capability-set consumption without direct table reads, profile version carried with cached decisions, externally owned catalog, authorization and editions. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

dataLifecycle.title: Veri Yaşam Döngüsü & Uyum
items: A composition names the tenant and the operator who published it, so KVKK/GDPR veri sınıflandırması, purpose, owner and retention approval are required before implementation; DSAR silme veya anonimleştirme yolu istenir for the operator identity carried in the transition history.
The transition history has its own saklama süresi, separate from the tenant business data it governs, because a rolled-back profile must still leave a defensible record of what was active when.
Profile versions and transitions are retained append-only so a historical capability state stays explainable, and stored profiles evolve by expand-contract rather than in-place rewrite.
dataLifecycle.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/dataLifecycle: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
dataLifecycle.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract dataLifecycle kapsamı. Kapsa: operator identity PII in transition history with KVKK/GDPR classification and DSAR path, a separate transition-history retention window, append-only versions and expand-contract evolution. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

observability.title: Gözlemlenebilirlik & Operasyon
items: Planned SLI/SLO metrik set includes capability-set resolution latency, validate failure rate, publish and rollback counts and time spent on a candidate version, on tenant-safe labels.
Structured log and trace records carry the tenant class, channel, previous version and new version; operator names and record contents are redacted and never become metric labels.
Alarm coverage includes a rollback spike, a validate failure surge after a catalog change and a tenant stuck on a candidate version; thresholds and the runbook require human approval.
observability.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/observability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
observability.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract observability kapsamı. Kapsa: resolution latency and validate failure SLIs, redacted version-scoped traces, rollback and stuck-candidate alerts with a human-approved runbook. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.

reliability.title: Dayanıklılık & Süreklilik
items: The dominant failure mode is a partially applied transition; the previously published version stays authoritative until publish completes, so a tenant is never left on a half-composed profile.
Publish and rollback are idempotent by construction: replaying the same transition for the same tenant, channel and target version yields the same published state under a bounded retry with backoff.
A repeatedly failing transition is routed to a dead-letter path for human review rather than blocking the tenant's queue, and a circuit breaker protects the shared composition path.
reliability.notes: mode-profile-composition-contract/reliability: planning-only governance contract; no runtime evidence or readiness claim.
reliability.prompt: Mode Profile Composition Contract reliability kapsamı. Kapsa: authoritative previous version during transition, idempotent publish and rollback with bounded retry, dead-letter routing without head-of-line blocking and circuit-breaker protection. Güvenlik sınırı: fixed exclusions and NO-GO cannot be relaxed. Çıktı: Produce planning evidence only.
